title: Codegen eval question bank
description: A versioned bank of typed codegen-eval cases (D1). Each case declares its clip, query shape, phrasing class, paraphrase distance, the question text, and a ground-truth expectation. The bank is the single self-describing source of truth: the per-case `expect` block is co-located so the answer key cannot drift from the case.

bank_version.description: Bumped when the bank's case set changes (the one-line growth knob from D1).

prompt_version.description: Provenance: the prompt-version hash the bank was authored against. Advisory only — replay derives the live hash from build_system_message(clip); this records what the author saw.

case_id.description: Stable slug (clip-shape-class-N). The fixture key on disk.

clip_id.description: Enum of canned.CLIPS keys (the drift guard test asserts this matches canned.clip_by_id).

distance.description: Paraphrase distance from the canned wording — powers the per-distance report cut.

question.description: The user question. maxLength is a literal mirror of server.MAX_QUERY_TEXT_LEN (a static schema cannot import it); the drift-guard test asserts equality.

answer.description: Ground truth for grounded cases; null for ungrounded. Count/presence answers are DERIVED from pinned programs, never hand-typed.
